title: Lakeview Drive | KEY.co
description_expanded: This stunning three-story home offers an exceptional retreat along 30A, boasting nine bedrooms and nine and a half baths, comfortably accommodating up to fifteen guests. Beautifully furnished and thoughtfully designed, this architectural gem blends timeless luxury with modern amenities. The expansive first-floor living area features hardwood floors, abundant natural light, and sophisticated interiors perfect for relaxation. Step outside to enjoy the summer kitchen, oversized pool, hot tub, and private dock, all ideal for entertaining. With breathtaking views of Eastern Lake and the Gulf of Mexico, the seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces creates the perfect backdrop for memorable gatherings. Each of the nine elegant bedrooms is outfitted with a king-sized bed for ultimate comfort, while the spa-like bathrooms offer a serene space to unwind. The well-appointed kitchen, with upgraded appliances and a large island, invites culinary creativity, while the spacious living room becomes a central hub for relaxation and conversation. Whether lounging by the pool, paddleboarding on the lake, or exploring the nearby shops and trails, this luxurious retreat captures the essence of 30A living, promising an unforgettable vacation experience.

Features: Outdoor chairs Outdoor grill Firepit Pool
